prompt: Flask already supports a SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED config option. Add an analogous SESSION_COOKIE_PRIORITY option, defaulting to None, following exactly the same pattern: register the default alongside the other SESSION_COOKIE_* defaults, add a get_cookie_priority accessor on SessionInterface next to get_cookie_partitioned, and read it in SecureCookieSessionInterface.save_session where the other cookie attributes are read.
